name: Kyushu Financial Group, Inc.
summary: Kyushu Financial Group, Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the banking business in Japan. It operates through the Banking and Leasing segments. The company offers financial services, including lease, credit card and credit guarantee, money loan, and financial instruments. It is also involved in DX solutions and payment collection services, e-commerce services, investment advisory services, collateral evaluation, worker dispatch operation, as well as fund formation and management services. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Kumamoto, Japan.
